qualifier: with heme biosynthesis and oxygen transport
name: Erythrocyte differentiation with heme biosynthesis and oxygen transport
rationale: Members cover primitive/definitive erythroid differentiation and the red-cell heme/oxygen-carrier programme; the heme biosynthesis and oxygen transport members are what the erythropoiesis confusables lack, while the confusable with heme lacks the differentiation subtypes.

core: Cell death on loss of survival cues
name: Survival-cue withdrawal death via dependence receptors and anoikis
rationale: Members concern death triggered when trophic or attachment signals are lost (unliganded dependence receptors, anoikis, involution, autophagic and developmental death), unlike confusables centred on p75NTR, apoptotic execution or neuronal/FOXO death.

qualifier: bidirectional, with VEGF and FGF production control
name: Endothelial angiogenic regulation including VEGF and FGF production control
rationale: All members regulate endothelial behaviour in vessel growth in both directions, and the theme uniquely includes control of VEGF/FGF production, endothelial activation and apoptosis, unlike the purely pro- or anti-sprouting confusables.

name: Bacterial pattern recognition by TLR2/4/5 and NOD1/2
rationale: Members detect bacterial ligands (LPS, lipopeptides, lipoteichoic acid, peptidoglycan, muramyl dipeptide) via TLR2/4/5-MyD88/IRAK4 and NOD1/2, distinguishing it from TRIF/TLR3, inflammasome/IL-1 and negative-regulation confusables.

core: Early neural plate and axial patterning
qualifier: axial mesoderm, floor plate and neural plate border
name: Neural plate, border and axial mesoderm midline specification
rationale: Members specify the neural plate, its border/neural crest and the axial mesoderm-notochord-floor plate midline along the dorsoventral axis, unlike confusables about hindbrain HOX, planar polarity/convergent extension or spinal cord patterning.

qualifier: retinal neurons, photoreceptors, lens and anterior segment
name: Eye development: retinal neurons, photoreceptors, lens, anterior segment
rationale: Members build eye tissues (retinal layers and neurons, photoreceptors, lens, cornea, iris, eyelid, optic cup), distinguishing it from confusables about phototransduction/retinoids, retinal vasculature, optic nerve or lacrimal gland.

name: Dendritic cell-centred leukocyte surface marker signatures
rationale: Members are surface-protein signatures of dendritic cells, monocytes, T and plasma cells plus butyrophilins, distinct from MHC class II processing, monocyte/lipid-antigen and T cell costimulation confusables.

name: NRF2- and p53-driven antioxidant and NADPH metabolic regulation
rationale: Members are NRF2 target programmes and its regulation together with p53/mTORC1 control of glycolysis, pentose phosphate shunt and NADP+ synthesis, unlike the HIF/hypoxia and FOXO confusables.

name: Transsulfuration, cysteine catabolism and sulfide oxidation
rationale: Members cover homocysteine-to-cysteine transsulfuration, cysteine/H2S breakdown, sulfide and sulfonate oxidation and the molybdenum cofactor of sulfite oxidase, unlike the selenium, glutathione, choline or vitamin B6 confusables.

name: E2F cell-cycle transcription under DREAM/pocket-protein repression
rationale: Members are E2F target networks driving G1/S and proliferation, including repression by DREAM and p107/p130-HDAC1, which the replication-licensing and G2/M confusables lack.

name: Hormonal glucose and fat storage control: insulin, adipocytes, thermogenesis
rationale: Members span insulin/incretin secretion and action, glucose and glycogen regulation, adipocyte differentiation, lipid droplets, triglyceride turnover and thermogenesis, unlike confusables focused on phospholipid, glycerol/fructose or glycogenolysis chemistry.

qualifier: proximal IRS/SHC adaptors to AKT2 and glycogen
name: Proximal insulin/IGF1 receptor signalling via IRS, SHC and AKT2
rationale: Members are insulin/IGF1 receptor adaptor signalling (IRS, SHC, SOS, AKT2) and its effects on glycogen and glucose uptake, distinguishing it from generic PI3K/AKT and GLUT4/adiponectin confusables.

qualifier: colony-stimulating factor control of granulocyte and monocyte-macrophage fates
name: CSF-driven granulocyte and monocyte-macrophage differentiation
rationale: Members regulate granulocyte, monocyte, macrophage and myeloid DC differentiation through M-CSF, G-CSF and GM-CSF signalling, unlike confusables on RUNX targets, erythroid/megakaryocyte lineages or bone marrow homeostasis.

name: Ubiquitin conjugation cascade and atypical-linkage polyubiquitin chains
rationale: Members cover E1/E2/E3 ubiquitin activation and transfer, free-chain and branched K6/K11/K27/K29 chain synthesis and ubiquitin-processing DUBs, unlike confusables on deubiquitination, proteasomal degradation or ERAD.

qualifier: E2F transcription, origin licensing, G2/M checkpoints
name: Cell-cycle progression: E2F transcription, origin licensing, G2/M checkpoints
rationale: Members span G1/S E2F/RB control, replication origin licensing, replication and DNA-damage checkpoints and G2/M entry in proliferating cells, whereas confusables centre on APC/C mitotic exit, spindle, cohesion and meiosis.

name: Retroviral replication and host restriction of foreign genomes
rationale: Members cover HIV entry, reverse transcription and integration plus host defences (APOBEC3 deamination, KRAB-ZFP/HUSH retroelement silencing, viral latency and transcription control), unlike confusables on immunoglobulin diversification, ADAR editing or DNA demethylation/repair.

name: Glucuronate-xylulose pathway and fructose catabolism
rationale: Members are glucuronate-to-xylulose-5-phosphate metabolism and fructose catabolism with their inborn errors (pentosuria, fructosuria, fructose intolerance), unlike galactose and non-oxidative pentose phosphate confusables.

qualifier: two-pore-domain K+ channels and Na+ transport
name: Resting potential control by two-pore K+ channels and Na+ transport
rationale: Members are K2P (TWIK/TREK/TASK/THIK/TRESK) and Ca2+-activated K+ channels plus Na+/K+ transport regulation setting resting potential and excitability, unlike P-type ATPase, chloride cotransporter or KATP channel confusables.

core: GPCR control of gut motility and secretion
name: Serotonin, muscarinic and tachykinin receptor control of gut motility
rationale: Members are serotonin, acetylcholine and tachykinin receptor signalling with gastric motility, acid secretion and intestinal contraction, unlike confusables on cAMP/PDE, histamine/serotonin synthesis or general smooth muscle relaxation.

core: Skeletal muscle contraction and fiber maintenance
qualifier: sarcomere assembly and calcineurin-regulated fiber size
name: Skeletal muscle sarcomere function and calcineurin-regulated fiber size
rationale: Members cover skeletal sarcomere assembly and contraction plus calcineurin/phosphatase control of fiber size, atrophy and adaptation, unlike confusables on myoblast/cardiac growth, neuromuscular junction or fiber-type transition.

qualifier: SUMOylation of transcription factors and RNA-binding proteins
name: SUMO conjugation cycle and SUMOylation of transcription factors
rationale: Members are SUMO maturation, E1/E2 transfer, desumoylation and SUMOylation of transcription factors and RNA-binding proteins, while confusables are SUMOylation of DNA repair, replication, nuclear envelope or chromatin targets.

qualifier: outer segment protein targeting and maintenance
name: Photoreceptor development and outer-segment protein targeting
rationale: Members concern rod/cone (and bipolar) development, photoreceptor morphogenesis and maintenance, and protein targeting to the outer segment/transition zone, unlike generic ciliary trafficking or broader eye-development confusables.

name: Microglial and astrocyte activation in amyloid-beta and tau pathology
rationale: Members regulate microglial and astrocyte activation alongside amyloid-beta formation/clearance and neurofibrillary tangles, the glial activation being what the amyloid-centred confusables lack.

name: Mitochondrial valine/isoleucine catabolism and organic acid repair
rationale: Members cover valine/isoleucine and short-chain acyl-CoA breakdown (ECHS1, HIBCH deficiencies), biotin-dependent carboxylation and 2-hydroxyglutarate/toxic metabolite repair, unlike the leucine-catabolism confusables.

qualifier: transcriptional control of apoptosis and G1 arrest
name: p53 transcriptional control of DNA-damage apoptosis and G1 arrest
rationale: Members are p53 regulation and its transcription of death genes, PUMA and p21 for DNA-damage apoptosis and G1 arrest, unlike confusables on p53 phosphorylation/radiation responses, ARF/INK4 senescence evasion or BH3-only mitochondrial steps.
